about_short_description.short_description: EcoSoul is a company that creates bio-based and organic home items.

product.name: Compostable Tableware
product.description: Plant-based disposable plates and bowls made from materials like palm leaves and sugarcane bagasse, designed for single-use dining and compostable disposal.

product.name: Compostable Cutlery
product.description: Disposable knives, forks, and spoons made from plant-based PLA, designed for single-use dining and certified compostable.

product.name: Compostable Straws
product.description: Plant-based, bendable straws made from corn starch (PLA), designed as a compostable alternative to plastic straws.

product.name: Compostable Hot and Cold Cups
product.description: Disposable cups made from upcycled plant fibers like bagasse and PLA, designed for hot and cold beverages and compostable disposal.

product.name: Compostable Resealable Bags
product.description: Plant-based resealable zip-lock bags made from PLA, designed for food storage and certified compostable.

product.name: Compostable Kitchen Bags
product.description: Plant-based compostable kitchen trash bags available in various sizes, designed for waste disposal and composting.
